sections.title: Brave Frontier Heroes
sections.content: The hero who ended the war between humans and dragons. It is said that he inherited the Crimson Spear, a weapon passed down through the generations. This spear was believed to have been bestowed upon his ancestors by the gods as a token of some covenant. However, due to certain events of the divine era, no one truly knows the exact circumstances. After experiencing the trauma of losing his parents in the war, he led a peaceful life with his younger sister. While he made a living as a hunter, having been raised a warrior, he was ill-suited to anything other than combat. This meant that all household chores and negotiations with the villagers were left entirely to his sister.

|member = |gamedebut = |aliases = |counterpart = Conquering Spear Serath |bf2 = true }} '''Serath''' is a character introduced in Brave Frontier II. ==In-Game Appearance== ==Background== ==History== ===Brave Frontier Heroes=== The hero who ended the war between humans and dragons. It is said that he inherited the Crimson Spear, a weapon passed down through the generations. This spear was believed to have been bestowed upon his ancestors by the gods as a token of some covenant. However, due to certain events of the divine era, no one truly knows the exact circumstances. After experiencing the trauma of losing his parents in the war, he led a peaceful life with his younger sister. While he made a living as a hunter, having been raised a warrior, he was ill-suited to anything other than combat. This meant that all household chores and negotiations with the villagers were left entirely to his sister. ==Artwork== {{CharacterImage |name = Serath |element = Fire |image1 = Navi chara bf2 211 0.png |image1note = Neutral |image2 = Navi chara bf2 211 1.png |image2note = Happy |image3 = Navi chara bf2 211 2.png |image3note = Angry |image4 = Navi chara bf2 211 3.png |image4note = Sad |image5 = Navi chara bf2 211 4.png |image5note = Shock |image6 = Navi chara bf2 211 5.png |image6note = Hurt |image7 = Navi chara bf2 211 6.png |image7note = }} ==Trivia==
